title: Jeremiah Taken to Egypt

questions.question: Who responded to Jeremiah when he finished speaking all the words of the Lord to the people?
options: Azariah the son of Hoshaiah and Johanan the son of Kareah and all the insolent men
questions.correctAnswer: Azariah the son of Hoshaiah and Johanan the son of Kareah and all the insolent men
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 43:2 (ESV): "Azariah the son of Hoshaiah and Johanan the son of Kareah and all the insolent men said to Jeremiah, 'You are telling a lie. The Lord our God did not send you to say, "Do not go to Egypt to live there..."'"

questions.question: What did the men accuse Jeremiah of doing? "You are telling a... The Lord our God did not send you..."
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 43:2 (ESV): "You are telling a lie. The Lord our God did not send you,"

questions.question: Who did these men claim had set Jeremiah against them, to deliver them to the Chaldeans?
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 43:3 (ESV): "but Baruch the son of Neriah has set you against us, to deliver us into the hand of the Chaldeans, that they may kill us or exile us to Babylon."

questions.question: Did Johanan the son of Kareah and all the commanders obey the voice of the Lord to remain in the land of Judah?
options: They sent Baruch to Babylon instead
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 43:4 (ESV): "So Johanan the son of Kareah and all the commanders of the forces and all the people did not obey the voice of the Lord, to remain in the land of Judah."

questions.question: Johanan and the commanders took all the remnant of Judah who had returned... and took them to the land of Egypt. Who was included in this group?
options: Men, women, children, the king's daughters, and every person Nebuzaradan had left with Gedaliah... also Jeremiah the prophet and Baruch
Only the men capable of fighting
Only those who volunteered to go
Everyone except Jeremiah, whom they left behind
questions.correctAnswer: Men, women, children, the king's daughters, and every person Nebuzaradan had left with Gedaliah... also Jeremiah the prophet and Baruch
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 43:6-7 (ESV): "the men, the women, the children, the princesses, and every person whom Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard had left... also Jeremiah the prophet and Baruch the son of Neriah. And they came into the land of Egypt, for they did not obey the voice of the Lord."

questions.question: Where did they arrive in the land of Egypt?
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 43:7 (ESV): "And they came into the land of Egypt... And they arrived at Tahpanhes."

questions.question: At Tahpanhes, what did the Lord tell Jeremiah to take in his hands?
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 43:9 (ESV): "Take in your hands large stones and hide them in the mortar in the pavement that is at the entrance to Pharaoh's palace in Tahpanhes,"

questions.question: Where was Jeremiah supposed to hide the large stones?
options: In the mortar in the pavement that is at the entrance to Pharaoh's palace in Tahpanhes
In the mud of the Nile river
questions.correctAnswer: In the mortar in the pavement that is at the entrance to Pharaoh's palace in Tahpanhes
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 43:9 (ESV): "hide them in the mortar in the pavement that is at the entrance to Pharaoh's palace in Tahpanhes, in the sight of the men of Judah."

questions.question: Who did the Lord say He would send and bring, to set his throne above these hidden stones?
options: Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon, my servant
questions.correctAnswer: Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon, my servant
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 43:10 (ESV): "Behold, I will send and take Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon, my servant, and he will set his throne above these stones that I have hidden, and he will spread his royal canopy over them."

questions.question: "He shall come and strike the land of... , giving over to the pestilence those who are doomed to the pestilence,"
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 43:11 (ESV): "He shall come and strike the land of Egypt, giving over to the pestilence those who are doomed to the pestilence,"

questions.question: "I shall kindle a fire in the temples of the... of Egypt, and he shall burn them and carry them away captive."
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 43:12 (ESV): "I shall kindle a fire in the temples of the gods of Egypt, and he shall burn them and carry them away captive."

questions.question: "And he shall clean the land of Egypt as a shepherd cleans his... of vermin, and he shall go away from there in peace."
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 43:12 (ESV): "And he shall clean the land of Egypt as a shepherd cleans his cloak of vermin, and he shall go away from there in peace."

questions.question: What specific religious monuments does the text say Nebuchadnezzar will break in pieces?
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 43:13 (ESV): "He shall break in pieces the obelisks of Heliopolis, which is in the land of Egypt,"

questions.question: What will happen to the temples of the gods of Egypt?
options: He shall burn them with fire
He shall convert them into storehouses
He shall steal their gold and leave them standing
They will sink into the sand
questions.correctAnswer: He shall burn them with fire
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 43:13 (ESV): "and the temples of the gods of Egypt he shall burn with fire."

questions.question: How does God refer to Nebuchadnezzar in verse 10, despite him being a pagan king?
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 43:10 (ESV): "Behold, I will send and take Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon, my servant,"

key_verse_text: "Behold, I will send and take Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon, my servant, and he will set his throne above these stones that I have hidden, and he will spread his royal canopy over them."
